title: Measurability of the approximate tangent projection of an integer multiplicity triple
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P any set and R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity triple in U (Lean IMRep U n) with weight μ_R = θHⁿ⌞M (R.measure). Then the map x ↦ p_{T_xM} from ℝ^P to the continuous linear endomorphisms of ℝ^P, where p_{T_xM} is the orthogonal projection onto T_xM := approxTangentPlane n M x (the approximate tangent plane of M at x when it exists, the zero subspace otherwise), is almost everywhere strongly measurable with respect to μ_R.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection) R.measure
